After procedures that leave wounds and scabs, such as mole removal or CO2 laser, do not apply sunscreen to the wound. Apply only to the surrounding skin and cover with tape or a hat, then once the wound has healed (usually about 1–2 weeks, confirmed by your doctor), apply carefully over the treated area as well.

Why should pink new skin
avoid UV after healing?
Pink new skin after a wound heals is sensitive to UV, so many doctors recommend thorough sun protection for at least about 2 months.
One study found less pigmentation in the group that started using sunscreen right after ablative laser treatment.
The American Academy of Dermatology advises avoiding the sun completely until the skin heals after a deep peel, and applying sunscreen every day once it has healed.
When can I start sunscreen after mole removal?

Once the wound has healed (usually about 1–2 weeks, confirmed by your doctor), apply it over the treated area too. Until then, avoid the wound, apply only to the surrounding skin, and cover with tape or a hat.
Can I apply sunscreen over the tape?
Do not apply it over tape or on the wound. Apply only to the skin around the tape, and block the sun with a hat or mask.
How should I care for pink skin after the scab falls off?
Be especially careful with UV while the new skin is pink. Apply carefully over the treated area, reapply every 2–3 hours, and keep this up for at least about 2 months.

Why avoid light for
48 hours after PDT?
Because the medication used reacts to light, your skin stays sensitive even to sunlight and bright indoor lighting for about 48 hours after treatment.
International clinics and acne information sites advise that sunscreen alone cannot protect the skin during this period and that light itself should be avoided.
After 48 hours, keep up daily sun protection.
If I apply sunscreen on the day of PDT, can I go out?
No. For about 48 hours after treatment, sunscreen alone is not enough. Stay indoors, and if you must go out, cover up with a hat and clothing.
Can I wear sunscreen when I go for PDT?
Some clinics ask you to come without makeup or sunscreen. Follow your clinic's instructions and, if needed, remove them with the cleansing milk before you go.
Can I use the products as usual after 48 hours?
Yes. From 48 hours onward, apply sunscreen every day and use the cleansing milk as usual. Flaking and redness may last about a week, so don't peel off flakes.
